title: Selection of the Minibar Charges the Closing Credit Release Is Put Against
content:
On a busy folio in the Hotel Rate Plans range the credit released at the close of a stay is not put against a single minibar line. Which minibar charges it is put against, and what the counted minibar figure then is, follow from the number of minibar charges on the folio and the number of on-site charges standing there.

Where the folio carries 4 or more minibar charges and the on-site charges standing on the folio number 8 or more, the credit is put against every minibar charge taken by the lead guest and the counted minibar figure is their total.

Where the folio carries 4 or more minibar charges and the on-site charges standing on the folio number fewer than 8, the credit is put against the largest minibar charge taken by the lead guest alone and the counted minibar figure is that charge.

In every other case the credit is put against the latest minibar charge taken by the lead guest alone and the counted minibar figure is that charge.

| Minibar charges on the folio | On-site charges on the folio | The counted minibar figure |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 4 or more | 8 or more | The total of every minibar charge taken by the lead guest |
| 4 or more | Fewer than 8 | The largest minibar charge taken by the lead guest alone |
| Fewer than 4 | Any number | The latest minibar charge taken by the lead guest alone |

*The combinations, on a hypothetical folio.* The lead guest's minibar charges are 12.00, 30.00, 9.00 and 25.00 USD, posted in that order, and the folio carries 9 on-site charges in all. With 4 minibar charges and 9 on-site charges the counted figure is their total, 76.00 USD. Were the folio to carry only 7 on-site charges, the counted figure would be the largest of them, 30.00 USD. Were only 3 minibar charges to stand on the folio, the counted figure would be the latest of them, whatever its size relative to the others.
